```python
# Hand-built minimal record: the rejection rule reads only posted_on, so no fixture is loaded.
VALID_RECORD = {"account": "4010", "amount": "125.00", "posted_on": "2026-01-15", "memo": "opening"}


def test_rejects_posted_on_in_the_future():
    record = dict(VALID_RECORD, posted_on="2026-03-02")
    with pytest.raises(ImportRejected, match="posted_on is in the future"):
        import_record(record, TODAY)


def test_imports_record_posted_today():
    record = dict(VALID_RECORD, posted_on=TODAY.isoformat())
    entry = import_record(record, TODAY)
    assert entry.posted_on == TODAY
```
